planets.name: LTT 1445 A c
planets.description: Transiting planet of LTT 1445 A with a 3.12-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: LTT 1445 A c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LTT 1445 A. Its orbit and size follow Winters et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
